final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS player_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.throwing_hand, s1.player_count, 1.0 * s1.player_count / NULLIF(s2.total_count, 0) AS share FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.throwing_hand, s3.player_count, s3.share, s3.share - s4.mean_share AS excess FROM step3 AS s3 CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4 WHERE s4.mean_share IS NOT NULL AND s3.share > s4.mean_share) SELECT SUM(player_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM step5
